_comment: Bauer MCP gateway config. TEMPLATE ONLY — copy to /data/company/mcp_servers.json on the volume and fill real values there. Never commit secrets to this file. Rationale is recorded in Bauer's internal tracker, not in this public repo.
_secrets_note: The $VAR values in microsoft_365.env are resolved by extensible-mcp from the API's environment; upstream's gateway forwards the MS365_MCP_* names used here (_FORWARDED_ENV_VARS). ZOHO_* and GITHUB_* are not forwarded, so put literal values for those in the copy on /data (never committed).

microsoft_365._status: VERIFIED against @softeria/ms-365-mcp-server@0.154.2, the version upstream's image pins.
microsoft_365._name: Must stay microsoft_365: the gateway's checks and blocked login tools key on the microsoft_365__ prefix.
microsoft_365._read_only: --read-only drops every non-GET tool before registration, and also narrows the scopes --login asks for. MS365_MCP_ENABLED_TOOLS names only read tools, so nothing writes even if the flag is dropped.
microsoft_365._teams: --org-mode turns on the Teams tools. The gateway has no checks for Teams tools; that is acceptable only because every Teams tool here is a read. Adding a Teams write needs a matching check in orchestrator/mcp_gateway.py first.
microsoft_365._scope: Mail, calendar and Teams reads only. No OneDrive (MS365_MCP_ONEDRIVE unset) and no SharePoint.
microsoft_365._login: --login must run with the same flags and tool list, or it asks for the wrong scopes. Use the command in bauer/README.md.

zoho._status: UNVERIFIED — do not enable until confirmed
zoho._confirm: extensible-mcp accepts a remote server as {"url": "https://..."} but cannot send auth headers. This works only if Zoho's endpoint carries the key in the URL; confirm the URL format before filling it in. The URL is a secret: put it only in the copy on /data.
zoho._covers: Zoho CRM, Books, Desk. Float Financial spend arrives already inside Books via zoho-float-sync, so Float needs no entry.

github._status: UNVERIFIED — do not enable until confirmed
github._confirm: Confirm the current official server invocation and transport before filling this in.
github._scope: Read-only to start. Scope any token to issues on bauer-automate repos.

filters._comment: Upstream's deny patterns (packages/core/mcp_servers.json.example) plus the fork's send patterns, in both underscore and hyphen forms (Microsoft tool names are hyphenated). Do not narrow this list. These are a second layer; read-only and the identity's granted scopes are the first. Switching to gated read/write means removing the send, reply and forward patterns on purpose.

load_control._comment: Refuses every runtime load_mcp_server call. extensible-mcp checks deny patterns first and allows everything when allow_url_patterns is empty, so upstream's "http://*" alone still lets any https:// server load. Configured servers above are not affected. To allow one remote server, keep "*" out of this list and name it in allow_url_patterns instead.
